name: rook-crawler
description: Rook Crawler + Stealth Proxy: Web crawler with Tor Browser, DoH/HTTPS, fingerprint rotation, AI intelligence, SQLite persistence, Puppeteer rendering, REST API. Works on Windows (PowerShell), macOS, Linux, Termux.
author: John Petty
_comment: Supports Windows PowerShell 7.6.5+, macOS, Linux, Termux. Uses cuimp for Chrome fingerprinting + TLS mimicry. Includes SQLite persistence, Puppeteer headless rendering, and REST API.

_features.persistence: SQLite database for storing crawl results and history
_features.rendering: Puppeteer headless browser for JavaScript-rendered pages
_features.ml: K-means clustering for link quality prioritization
_features.api: REST API for remote crawling operations
_features.realtime: WebSocket support for live crawler updates
